title: Map 1: size of gain against starting point on the demand curve
description: One sector at 0.1% of spending, one worker type. The sector's productivity rises by a factor A. The starting point is how saturated demand is in the base year, on the curve shared by the young (10%) and mature (80%) starting points (σ ≈ 0.875). Outcome: change in sector employment. Expect Bessen's hump: employment rises for young sectors and modest gains, and falls for mature sectors or large gains.
